overview: This item focuses on building a small but realistic end-to-end demo that showcases how to use Ash with Jido in a way that others can easily replicate. The demo should define one or two Ash resources (e.g., tasks, projects, or tickets), expose their key actions via ash_jido, and then connect them to a simple Jido agent that can perform operations like listing, creating, and updating records. The goal is to demonstrate best practices around resource configuration, action selection, and how to phrase tool schemas so that LLMs can use them effectively. The deliverable is a runnable example (ideally a minimal mix project or umbrella app folder) with clear README-style documentation explaining the integration strategy and steps to follow. This demo will serve as the primary reference for onboarding and as a template for future Ash + Jido projects.
title: Create demo showing Ash + Jido integration strategy
